description: Returns the payment terms for https://horizonpulse.dev/api/fema/declarations (base $0.005; USDC on Base only); this tool never runs the check or pays. Pay the 402 over HTTP with x402 v2: GET with optional state=FL, disasterNumber=4955, incidentType=Hurricane, declarationType=DR|EM|FM, since=YYYY-MM-DD, limit=1-100 (default 20). Declaration summaries only.. FEMA disaster declaration summaries (OpenFEMA DisasterDeclarationsSummaries v2): id, state, type, dates, incident type, title, area, FIPS and program flags. Uses the OpenFEMA API. Not affiliated with or endorsed by FEMA or DHS. Reporting record only; not for reidentifying people or deciding rights or benefits. Bad input, no match or source down: not charged. USDC on Base only.
